properties.description: The OpenCode half of the coherence loop's trigger — an adapter that translates OpenCode's plugin hooks (chat.message, tool.execute.after, the session.idle event) into the hook-event JSON tools/loop_nudge.py reads on stdin, and delivers its sentence through experimental.chat.system.transform. Holds no judgement; shipped in the kit under plugins/ and installed into .opencode/plugins/ (project) or ~/.config/opencode/plugins/ (machine). Reviewed 2026-09-14 against OpenCode 1.18.31's plugin types, loader and tool naming.
properties.name: reflow2-loop-nudge.js
